concepts.topic_fa: مرجع/مشتق، OLTP/OLAP، ETL/reverse ETL
concepts.topic_en: Record/derived, OLTP/OLAP, ETL/reverse ETL
concepts.decision_fa: run و policy مرجع؛ retrieval و dashboard مشتق؛ تحلیلِ offline از manifest پایدار.
concepts.decision_en: Runs and policies are the records; retrieval and dashboards are derived; the offline analytics run off stable manifests.

concepts.topic_fa: build/buy، کلاود، توزیع، microservice/serverless
concepts.topic_en: Build/buy, cloud, distribution, microservices/serverless
concepts.decision_fa: adapter و engine موجود؛ worker جدا برای کار طولانی؛ استقرار اولیه محدود و تصمیمِ توزیع مستند.
concepts.decision_en: We reuse the adapters and engines that exist, give the long-running jobs their own worker, and write down the deployment and distribution decisions up front.

evidence_fa: یه ADR با دو گزینه بنویس و روی هزینه/latency/پیچیدگی بسنج.
evidence_en: Write an ADR weighing two options on cost, latency, and complexity.

concepts.topic_fa: response time، throughput، percentile، tail latency
concepts.topic_en: Response time, throughput, percentiles, tail latency
concepts.decision_fa: admission و completion جدا؛ صف، صدک ۹۵ و retry storm در load test.
concepts.decision_en: Admission and completion get measured separately, and the load test covers the queues, the p95, and the retry storms.

concepts.topic_fa: SLO/SLA، reliability، overload، maintainability
concepts.topic_en: SLO/SLA, reliability, overload, maintainability
concepts.decision_fa: SLO آموزشی، error budget، backpressure، ران‌بوک و deployment تکرارپذیر.
concepts.decision_en: The SLOs are experimental; the rest — error budgets, backpressure, runbooks, repeatable deployments — is the day-to-day kit.

evidence_fa: burst رو تزریق کن و نمودارِ queue/latency/error بکش.
evidence_en: Inject a burst and plot queue, latency, and errors.

concepts.topic_fa: relational/document، normalization، ORM، schema-on-read/write
concepts.topic_en: Relational/document, normalization, ORM, read/write schemas
concepts.decision_fa: رابطهٔ tenant/run نرمال؛ payload سند versioned؛ JSON مرزِ constraint را حذف نمی‌کند.
concepts.decision_en: The tenant/run relations stay normalized, the document payloads carry a version, and JSON never takes the place of a constraint.

concepts.topic_fa: graph، declarative query، star/snowflake/OBT، CQRS/event sourcing
concepts.topic_en: Graphs, declarative queries, star/snowflake/OBT, CQRS/event sourcing
concepts.decision_fa: dependency سرویس با graph منطقی؛ SQL محدود؛ OLAP fact/dimension؛ session log با state مشتق.
concepts.decision_en: A logical service graph, SQL that stays bounded, analytical facts and dimensions, and a session log with derived state.

evidence_fa: FKِ cross-tenant رو رد کن و projection رو از event بازسازی کن.
evidence_en: Reject a cross-tenant FK and rebuild the projection from the event.

concepts.topic_fa: WAL، B-tree، LSM، SSTable، Bloom، compaction
concepts.topic_en: WAL, B-trees, LSM, SSTables, Bloom, compaction
concepts.decision_fa: WAL برای recovery؛ index برای claim؛ گزینهٔ LSM در log store؛ false positiveِ Bloom صحت را تغییر ندهد.
concepts.decision_en: WAL for recovery, indexes for the claims, LSM as the log-store alternative — and a Bloom false positive must never change the correctness.

concepts.topic_fa: secondary/local/global index، columnar، compression، materialization، text/vector
concepts.topic_en: Secondary/local/global indexes, columnar, compression, materialization, text/vector
concepts.decision_fa: lookup به‌اندازهٔ tenant؛ telemetry زمان‌محور؛ eval ستونی؛ retrieval lexical/dense با benchmark.
concepts.decision_en: Lookups stay tenant-local, telemetry is time-based, the eval runs columnar, and the lexical/dense retrieval gets benchmarked.

evidence_fa: explain query و مقایسهٔ recall/latency سه روشِ retrieval رو ثبت کن.
evidence_en: Record the explain plan and the recall/latency of three retrieval methods.

concepts.topic_fa: JSON/Protobuf/Avro، default، unknown field، backward/forward
concepts.topic_en: JSON/Protobuf/Avro, defaults, unknown fields, backward/forward
concepts.decision_fa: envelope نسخه‌دار؛ rolloutِ producer/consumer؛ golden fixture قدیمی و جدید.
concepts.decision_en: A versioned envelope, producer/consumer rollouts, and golden fixtures for both the old and the new.

concepts.topic_fa: DB/RPC/event dataflow، durable execution، schema lifecycle
concepts.topic_en: DB/RPC/event dataflow, durable execution, schema lifecycle
concepts.decision_fa: HTTP هم‌زمان برای query، event ناهم‌زمان برای تغییر؛ expand/migrate/contract و mapper manifest.
concepts.decision_en: Sync HTTP for the queries, async events for the changes, expand/migrate/contract, and mapper manifests.

evidence_fa: consumer قبلی رو با event تازه و replay قدیمی تست کن.
evidence_en: Run an old consumer against a new event and an old replay.

concepts.topic_fa: single/multi/leaderless، sync/async، snapshot، failover، log methods
concepts.topic_en: Single/multi/leaderless, sync/async, snapshots, failover, log methods
concepts.decision_fa: یک primary برای budget/claim؛ logical CDC؛ snapshot هماهنگ؛ HA مشروط به writer fencing.
concepts.decision_en: One primary for the budgets and claims, logical CDC, coordinated snapshots, and HA with writer fencing.

concepts.topic_fa: read-your-writes، monotonic/prefix، quorum، conflict/version vector، tombstone
concepts.topic_en: Read-your-writes, monotonic/prefix, quorum, conflicts/version vectors, tombstones
concepts.decision_fa: token پیشرفت برای خواندن؛ primary برای guard؛ در budget سراغ multi-leader نمی‌رویم؛ افق حذف صریح.
concepts.decision_en: Progress tokens for the reads, the primary for the guard, no multi-leader writes on the budget, and an explicit deletion horizon.

evidence_fa: replica lag و failover رو تزریق کن و read-after-write رو بررسی کن.
evidence_en: Inject replica lag and failover, then check read-after-write.

concepts.topic_fa: range/hash، consistent hashing، mod N، virtual bucket، hotspot
concepts.topic_en: Range/hash, consistent hashing, mod N, virtual buckets, hotspots
concepts.decision_fa: telemetry با زمان+tenant؛ run با hash؛ tenant بزرگ virtual bucket؛ quota از hotspot دفاع می‌کند.
concepts.decision_en: Telemetry keyed by time and tenant, hashed runs, virtual buckets for the big tenants, and quotas that shield you from a hotspot.

concepts.topic_fa: routing، rebalancing، shard lifecycle، secondary local/global
concepts.topic_en: Routing, rebalancing, shard lifecycle, local/global secondary indexes
concepts.decision_fa: mapping نسخه‌دار با epoch؛ migration topic با drain؛ retrieval cross-shard fan-out هزینه دارد.
concepts.decision_en: A versioned mapping with epochs, topic migrations that drain first, and an explicit cost for cross-shard retrieval.

evidence_fa: یه tenant پرمصرف و تغییرِ partition mapping رو بدون شکستِ ترتیب اجرا کن.
evidence_en: Run a noisy tenant and a partition remapping without breaking the order.

concepts.topic_fa: ACID/MVCC، read committed/SI، lost update/write skew/phantom
concepts.topic_en: ACID/MVCC, read committed/SI, lost update/write skew/phantoms
concepts.decision_fa: budget reservation و claim با شرط اتمی؛ snapshot isolation به‌تنهایی سقف مجموع را حفظ نمی‌کند.
concepts.decision_en: The budget reservation and the claim stay atomic, because snapshot isolation on its own doesn't protect the aggregate cap.

concepts.topic_fa: serial execution/2PL/SSI، retry، 2PC، idempotency
concepts.topic_en: Serial execution/2PL/SSI, retries, 2PC, idempotency
concepts.decision_fa: constraint و قفل، یا serializable با retry؛ SQL inbox+effect اتمی؛ sink بیرونی قرارداد جدا.
concepts.decision_en: You get constraints and locks, or serializable with retries; the SQL inbox and the effect commit together; and the external sink keeps its own contract.

evidence_fa: دو درخواستِ هم‌زمانِ بودجه و crash بین effect/offset رو تست کن.
evidence_en: Test two concurrent budget requests and a crash between the effect and the offset.

concepts.topic_fa: partial failure، timeout/TCP/queue، clocks/skew/pause
concepts.topic_en: Partial failures, timeouts/TCP/queues, clocks/skew/pauses
concepts.decision_fa: deadline و outcome نامعلوم؛ event/observed/ingested جدا؛ pause worker و GC در تست.
concepts.decision_en: Deadlines with unknown outcomes, the three timestamps kept apart, and worker/GC pauses in the tests.

concepts.topic_fa: lease/fencing، majority، Byzantine، safety/liveness/system model
concepts.topic_en: Leases/fencing, majority, Byzantine faults, safety/liveness/system models
concepts.decision_fa: epoch در sink enforce؛ خروجیِ مدل ورودی نامطمئن؛ baselineِ crash-fault و توقف امن در partition.
concepts.decision_en: The sink enforces the epoch, the model's output counts as untrusted input, the crash-fault baseline holds, and the partition stops safely.

evidence_fa: worker زامبی و پاسخِ دیررس بساز و stale commit رو رد کن.
evidence_en: Build a zombie worker and a late reply, and reject the stale commit.

concepts.topic_fa: linearizability/serializability، CAP/PACELC، ID/Lamport/HLC
concepts.topic_en: Linearizability/serializability, CAP/PACELC, IDs/Lamport/HLC
concepts.decision_fa: promotion و ownership نیازمند CAS معتبر؛ UUID ترتیب global نمی‌سازد؛ ساعت منطقی فقط برچسبِ causal است.
concepts.decision_en: Promotion and ownership need an authoritative CAS; a UUID gives you no global order; and a logical clock only labels causality.

concepts.topic_fa: consensus log/epoch/quorum، coordination/discovery
concepts.topic_en: Consensus logs/epochs/quorums, coordination/discovery
concepts.decision_fa: به هماهنگیِ ابزار HA تکیه می‌کنیم؛ الگوریتم consensus تازه نمی‌نویسیم؛ minority حق dispatch حساس ندارد.
concepts.decision_en: We lean on the existing HA coordination, we don't write a new consensus algorithm, and a minority can't authorize a sensitive dispatch.

evidence_fa: تاریخچهٔ claim/promotion رو با یه oracle محدود خطی‌سنجی کن.
evidence_en: Check the claim/promotion history against a bounded linearizability oracle.

concepts.topic_fa: bounded/unbounded، UNIX pipeline، external sort، object store، DAG
concepts.topic_en: Bounded/unbounded inputs, UNIX pipelines, external sort, object storage, DAGs
concepts.decision_fa: rebuild از manifest immutable؛ pipeline استخراج/chunk/embed/eval؛ spill برای data بزرگ.
concepts.decision_en: We rebuild from immutable manifests, the extraction/chunk/embed/eval pipelines spill the big inputs.

concepts.topic_fa: MapReduce/dataflow، shuffle/join، skew/straggler، attempts، atomic publish
concepts.topic_en: MapReduce/dataflow, shuffle/joins, skew/stragglers, attempts, atomic publication
concepts.decision_fa: خروجیِ attemptها جدا؛ manifest فقط برنده؛ همهٔ chunkها پیش از pointer نسل؛ backfill/analytics.
concepts.decision_en: Each attempt keeps its own output, only the winner gets a manifest, every chunk lands before the pointer moves, and backfill/analytics read from there.

evidence_fa: mapper/embedding attempt رو kill کن و خروجیِ ناقص رو نامرئی نگه دار.
evidence_en: Kill a mapper/embedding attempt and keep the incomplete output invisible.

concepts.topic_fa: broker/log، offset، partition، backpressure، DLQ، retention
concepts.topic_en: Brokers/logs, offsets, partitions, backpressure, DLQ, retention
concepts.decision_fa: ترتیبِ entity؛ poison event به‌وضعیت degraded؛ افق WAL+Kafka؛ مصرف‌کنندهٔ مستقل.
concepts.decision_en: The order is per entity, a poison event marks things degraded, WAL and Kafka share one horizon, and the consumers stay independent.

concepts.topic_fa: dual write/outbox، snapshot/compaction، state-stream، joins/windows/watermark، exactly-once
concepts.topic_en: Dual writes/outbox, snapshot/compaction, state-stream, joins/windows/watermarks, exactly-once
concepts.decision_fa: seed+delta؛ deletion guard؛ اصلاحِ window؛ effectively-once تنها داخل مرزِ اثبات‌شده.
concepts.decision_en: Seed plus deltas, a deletion guard, window corrections, and effectively-once only inside the boundaries we've actually proven.

evidence_fa: overlap، reorder، delete و outage خارج از retention رو آزمایش کن.
evidence_en: Test overlap, reordering, deletes, and an outage beyond the retention.

concepts.topic_fa: derived/unbundled، dataflow/RPC، causality، migration، lambda/kappa
concepts.topic_en: Derived/unbundled systems, dataflow/RPC, causality, migration, lambda/kappa
concepts.decision_fa: context از log مشتق می‌شود؛ query هم‌زمان؛ shadow generation و reprocessing با یک mapper نسخه‌دار.
concepts.decision_en: The context is derived from the log, the queries are synchronous, and the shadow generation and the reprocessing share one versioned mapper.

concepts.topic_fa: timeliness/integrity، constraint/coordination، async apology، audit/checker
concepts.topic_en: Timeliness/integrity, constraints/coordination, async apologies, audits/checkers
concepts.decision_fa: تازگی جدا از صحت؛ guard هم‌زمان برای budget؛ reconciliation بیرونی؛ checksum در cut مشترک.
concepts.decision_en: Freshness is a different thing from integrity; the budget guard is synchronous, the reconciliation is external, and the checksums run in the same cut.

evidence_fa: checkerِ مرجع/مشتق رو در cut یکسان اجرا کن و اصلاحِ drift رو ثبت کن.
evidence_en: Run the record/projection checker in the same cut and record the drift repair.

concepts.topic_fa: bias/proxy/feedback loop، explainability، algorithmic exclusion
concepts.topic_en: Bias/proxies/feedback loops, explainability, algorithmic exclusion
concepts.decision_fa: گزارش agent امتیازِ کارکنان نیست؛ عدم‌قطعیت و حق اعتراض؛ eval per-family برای کورشدن نسبت به رخدادهای کم‌تکرار.
concepts.decision_en: No automatic employee scores, real uncertainty and a right to challenge, and per-family evals so the rare failures don't slip through.

concepts.topic_fa: surveillance/consent/power، minimization، retention، erasure
concepts.topic_en: Surveillance/consent/power, minimization, retention, erasure
concepts.decision_fa: آزمایشگاه مصنوعی؛ محدودیتِ هدف؛ redact کردن trace؛ حذف متن/vector/cache/backup و restore guard.
concepts.decision_en: The lab is synthetic, the purpose is limited, the traces are redacted, and deletion covers text, vector, cache, and backup — with a restore guard on top.

evidence_fa: دادهٔ حذف‌شده و دسترسیِ لغوشده رو در replay/restore و citation امتحان کن.
evidence_en: Test erased and revoked data in replay, restore, and citations.
